path='programs/task-fec6edee.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = all(grid[y][x] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                         if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1))
            interior = all(grid[y][x] == bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1))
            if border and interior:
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 == 1 and (c1-c0-1) % 2 == 1 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
